about_the_game:
Game Description Translation:

Immerse yourself in this deep, strategic mobile industry simulation game! Step into the role of a visionary tech tycoon and build your mobile empire from the ground up. Manage every facet of your company—oversee departments, design cutting-edge smartphones, develop proprietary operating systems, negotiate supply chains, and orchestrate high-stakes product launches. Climb to the pinnacle of the mobile era and prove yourself as the ultimate champion of the smartphone revolution!

Gameplay Features

  • Corporate Management
    Command specialized departments, each with unique roles and functions. Recruit talent across diverse roles to boost efficiency, but tread carefully—employee personalities can make or break your team’s performance.

  • Dynamic Design & Development
    Craft smartphones with limitless creativity. Hardware specs, software ecosystems, and OS choices (build from scratch or adopt open-source?) all lie in your hands. Negotiate fiercely with suppliers to slash costs, then set the perfect launch price to dominate the market.

  • Global Markets & Stock Trading
    Strategize across worldwide markets—balance investments and nurture key partnerships. Take your company public to attract investors, or dive into stock trading to flex your financial mastery.

Will you seize the throne of the mobile era?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: This is a simulated business game with the goal of designing and manufacturing mobile phones and building a business empire. Here you will manage various departments of the company, design mobile phones, develop systems, supply chain negotiations, and mobile phone releases!
